research.scope: Bounded second expansion: 16 new verified model/family records, 27 documented article or size variants, 18 manufacturer source pages. Includes 19 separate image reference records (16 new products and 3 existing models).
research.verificationPolicy: Facts derive from explicit manufacturer text or public product article metadata. Images, generated outputs and a user's bike photograph never establish compatibility. Listed size/colour options are not multiplied into invented SKUs. Sources may be cached; review date does not guarantee current inventory or pricing.

research.imagePolicy: These URLs are references, not bundled original assets.
